svg.title: Rigid colliders attached to soft-frames
svg.desc: A soft-body with two clusters, each carrying a rigid collider (a triangle and a box). At rest both colliders are upright; once the soft-body bends, each rigid collider follows the position and orientation of its own cluster without deforming.

g.text: Each collider is attached to the soft-frame of one cluster.
The colliders move and rotate independently, without deforming.
